emily: quick heads-up 1: repro across infra on nova13b-int3: after a prefill-split (large system prompt then user stream) the tail distributions diverge between coldstarts. looks like rot_scale toggles mid-run and kv_index sometimes shows a one-token offset. anyone seen prefill-split specific handshakes?
ryan: what quant config? int3 or int4? and are you using per-channel scales?
emily: int3, `per_channel=true`, `sym=false`. repro cmd: `./bench/run.sh --model nova13b --quant int3 --prompt samples/huge_system + samples/streaming_user --seed 7 --prefill-split`
sasha: can you paste the minimal log excerpt? especially any `KV_INDEX_OFFBY` or `rot_scale` prints.
emily: log snip: ```
[2026-03-21T09:12:03Z] seq=12048 model=nova13b quant=int3 rot_scale=1.000000
[2026-03-21T09:12:04Z] prefill-split: flush=1 prefill_len=8192 inflight=384
[2026-03-21T09:12:06Z] WARNING: KV_INDEX_OFFBY expected=8192 observed=8193
[2026-03-21T09:12:06Z] rot_scale adjusted -> 0.999912
[2026-03-21T09:12:07Z] WARNING: shard-handshake delayed by 2ms
```
liam: interesting. sounds like a race at the prefill boundary + RoPE wrap. try setting `ROPE_CLAMP=0` to force exact scaling and `KV_PREFETCH=0` to avoid split-prefetch overlap. also run with `--seq-limit 65536` so we don't clip.
emily: tried ROPE_CLAMP=0 and KV_PREFETCH=0, divergence postponed but still happens on different seeds. toggling `ROPE_STRIDE` between 512/1024 moves the point where rot_scale flips.
ryan: could be quant rounding + rot-phase discontinuity at shard join. does this reproduce on dedicated? Sasha, any kernel differences on dedicated vs hosted?
sasha: dedicated uses fused-attn-v2 kernel for this model+seq profile; hosted picks legacy path for int3. i'll spin up a dedicated job to compare.
emily: disabling cache entirely (`REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=0`) removes KV_INDEX warnings but rot_scale still fluctuates, so two layers: kv handshake and rot scaling.
liam: file a triage ticket and attach the reproducible prompt, seeds, and the `ROPE_DEBUG=1` dump. I'll try bisecting on rot_scale update code.
infra-bot: created ticket ENGML-8123: "prefill-split rot_scale flip + kv index offset on nova13b-int3" https://redwood/ENGML-8123
emily: thanks. assigning to @liam @sasha. i'll upload repro artifacts to the ticket and run a cluster compare (hosted vs dedicated) and include kernel selection traces. :+1:
ryan: if it's reproducible across kernels we should add an eval that streams long system prompts with prefill-split to catch this before onboarding. small note: add seed sweep 1..10.
liam: agreed. will add it to the onboarding smoke checklist (longprefill-split test).
